description: This file defines a React component `ChromefulComponentBlockElement` used within a rich text editor to render, edit, and manage block elements with a chrome-like UI, including toolbar actions and dialog controls. It includes subcomponents for rendering block primitives and an editing form.

methods.name: ChromefulComponentBlockElement
methods.description: Main React component rendering a block element with chrome UI, toolbar, and editing dialog.

methods.name: DefaultToolbarWithChrome
methods.description: Default toolbar component with edit and delete actions.

methods.name: FormValue
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering a form for editing the block's preview properties, handling validation and submission.

methods.name: BlockPrimitive
methods.description: Subcomponent wrapping block content with a visual indicator when selected.
